Population increased in Hampshire

The estimated population of Hampshire in 2024 was 1,447,214 usual residents, a rise of 1.0% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Hampshire increased by 2.9%.

Age profile of Hampshire

The average (median) age stayed at 44.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Hampshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Hampshire's population of 1,447,214 usual residents was made up of:

  • 255,231 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.6%)
  • 867,211 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.9%)
  • 324,772 people aged 65 years and over, (22.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Hampshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22.4% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Hampshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Hampshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Hampshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,766 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 12,551 births and 14,317 deaths in Hampshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 8,159 (0.6%). There were 62,913 people entering the area and 54,754 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Hampshire's population of 7,129 (0.5%) as a result of 11,775 people entering the area and 4,646 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Hampshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Hampshire in mid-2023 is 1,433,542.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 3,581 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 1,402 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 4,983 people.
